P_and_Q.body: This question resolves as YES if both the European Central Bank increases its bond purchases by more than 20% by 2029 and the Eurozone's housing market experiences a boom by 2031, as reported by the European Central Bank's official website (ecb.europa.eu) and Bloomberg (bloomberg.com) on December 31, 2031.
